tasks.name: רוב הגדולים מ-12
tasks.src: l=>{ const b=l.filter(x=>x>12), s=l.filter(x=>x<=12); return b.length>s.length?b:s; }
tasks.note: Held-out: keeps the bigger group among values >12 and values <=12 (the small group on a tie), preserving order.

tasks.name: רוב הקטנים מ-12
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=l.filter(x=>x<12), b=l.filter(x=>x>=12); return s.length>=b.length?s:b; }
tasks.note: Held-out: keeps the bigger group among values <12 and values >=12 (the small group on a tie). The <12 / >=12 split is not a shelf filter.

tasks.name: רוב הקטנים מ-11
tasks.src: l=>{ const s=l.filter(x=>x<11), b=l.filter(x=>x>=11); return s.length>=b.length?s:b; }
tasks.note: Held-out: keeps the bigger group among values <11 and values >=11 (the small group on a tie).

tasks.name: רוב זוגי - הורד את הזוגיים
tasks.note: Held-out: if more than half of the values are even, drop the evens; otherwise drop the odds.

tasks.name: ראשון גדול מאחרון - מיין, אחרת בלי הראשון
tasks.note: Held-out: sorts ascending when the first element is larger than the last, otherwise drops the first element.

tasks.name: עליות מול ירידות
tasks.src: l=>{ let u=0,d=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++){ if(l[i]>l[i-1]) u++; else d++; } return u>d?[...l].reverse():l.slice(1); }
tasks.note: Held-out: counts rises and falls between neighbours; more rises -> reverse, otherwise drop the first element.

tasks.name: זוגיים מול גדולים מ-12
tasks.note: Held-out: if there are more even values than values above 12, drop the first element; otherwise reverse.

tasks.name: ארוכה ממוינת, קצרה בלי זוגיים
tasks.note: Held-out: lists longer than 4 are sorted ascending, shorter ones lose their even values.
